notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, untapping any land.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
